query: SELECT event_type,action,actor_login,created_at,updated_at,title,body,comment_id,comments,state,closed_at,file_time,repo_name,number FROM github_events WHERE repo_name='prebid/prebid-universal-creative' AND number=19 AND event_type IN ('IssuesEvent','IssueCommentEvent') ORDER BY created_at,file_time FORMAT JSON

data.title: Add Bidder query params to the cookiesync script
data.body:
As described by https://github.com/prebid/prebid-server/issues/490, this cookiesync script will break GDPR in AMP pages if used [in the normal documented way](http://prebid.org/dev-docs/show-prebid-ads-on-amp-pages.html#user-sync).

To fix this, we need:

1. The cookiesync script to accept bidder params in the query string, so they can be used in the `amp-iframe`
2. Use these bidders in the `/cookie_sync` call, as documented [here](https://github.com/prebid/prebid-server/blob/master/docs/endpoints/cookieSync.md).
3. Update [the docs](http://prebid.org/dev-docs/show-prebid-ads-on-amp-pages.html#user-sync) to show publishers how to do it.
